GLEAN_INSTANCE.title: Glean instance
GLEAN_INSTANCE.description: The subdomain of your Glean backend: the part before -be.glean.com (for example acme for https://acme-be.glean.com). Shown as the backend domain under Server instance in Glean admin → About Glean, and in the MCP server URL from Glean's MCP Configurator (Settings → Third party apps and MCP).
